name: inspira-animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
description: A connector graphic: four small circular nodes on the left feed through gently bowed hairlines into one larger circle on the right, while a coloured light runs along each path in turn.
use: A hub should read as connected to several inputs, with a slow moving light hinting at flow.
avoid: It needs refs on a container plus two elements each and a positioned parent; alone it renders nothing.
a11y: Decorative SVG with no title or aria-hidden, and the endless beam loop never checks reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a near-black stage, four small round outlined buttons stack down the left, each holding a tiny coloured shape. Four faint grey curves bow rightward into a larger circle holding a purple atom, its ring picked out in indigo.
behaves: Each path carries a short colour gradient that slides from the source node to the hub on a loop, staggered per beam. The lines are recomputed when the container resizes.
customise: Give it container, from and to refs; curvature, reverse, both gradient colours, path colour, width, opacity, delay and duration are all props.
weight: light: A single SVG path and one looping gradient animation per beam; the demo mounts four.
